ideas.title: The Scale of Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of childcare fraud in Minnesota, comparing it with other states and the effectiveness of current legislation
ideas.angle: Comparative analysis of childcare fraud across states

ideas.insight: Understanding the scale and legislative response to childcare fraud in Minnesota can reveal gaps in current systems and areas for improvement
